Show how an empty MIME type is rejected consistently.

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"bytes":[84,104,105,115,32,105,115,32,97,32,112,108,97,105,110,32,116,101,120,116,32,102,105,108,101,32,102,111,114,32,116,101,115,116,105,110,103,46,10],"config":{},"filename":"plain.txt","kind":"bytes","mime_type":""}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await;
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
